items.name: division-ds-base
items.title: Division DS base
items.description: Tokens, style sheets and shared helpers. Every component depends on it. Then add @import "./division-ds/styles/division-ds.css"; after @import "tailwindcss"; in your CSS entry.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Avatar. Best for: Showing who a person is, next to their name, as in a roster row, a comment or an account menu.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Badge. Best for: You need to label a status with a word and a tone, like an order state or a sync result.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Button. Best for: An action on this page, like submit, save or open a dialog.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox. Best for: An on/off choice that applies when the form is saved, or a parent whose children are partly selected.

items.name: divider
items.title: Divider
items.description: Divider. Best for: A thin line between groups of content, labelled when it starts a new section.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: Icon button
items.description: Icon button. Best for: An action shown as a single icon, with a label that names the action.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Input. Best for: Single-line text, inside a FormField.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Kbd. Best for: Showing a keyboard shortcut next to the action it triggers, with one Kbd per key.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: Link. Best for: Text that takes you somewhere: another page, a section or another site.

items.name: loading-animation
items.title: Loading animation
items.description: Loading animation. Best for: A wait that takes over a whole panel or page, like a route loading, a report building or a first sync.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Progress. Best for: Showing how far a measurable task has got. Switch to indeterminate once you no longer know how much is left.

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio
items.description: Radio. Best for: One choice from a short set, up to about seven, all shown at once.

items.name: score-ring
items.title: Score ring
items.description: Score ring. Best for: A 0 to 100 score with good and bad bands, like an audit, a health check or a quality score. Several side by side read as one report.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Select. Best for: One choice from a list of about five options or more.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Skeleton. Best for: A region whose content is loading, shown as placeholders in its shape inside one SkeletonGroup.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Slider. Best for: A value or range on a track, where the rough position matters and the value is shown.

items.name: sparkline
items.title: Sparkline
items.description: Sparkline. Best for: You want the shape of a recent series, not its values. Think of a reading over the last hour.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Spinner. Best for: A short wait with no known end, inside a control or a line of text.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Switch. Best for: An on/off setting that takes effect the moment it's flipped.

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: Tag. Best for: A removable chip, such as an active filter or a selected value.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Textarea. Best for: Free text over several lines, inside a FormField.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Tooltip. Best for: Extra detail on hover or focus for an element that can take focus, such as an IconButton.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Accordion. Best for: Sections people scan by heading and open one or two of: frequently asked questions (FAQ), grouped settings, long specifications.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Alert. Best for: A message that sits in the page and stays there: a warning about this screen, or a failed load with a retry.

items.name: approval-request
items.title: Approval request
items.description: Approval request. Best for: An assistant is about to send, change or spend something outside the conversation.

items.name: avatar-group
items.title: Avatar group
items.description: Avatar group. Best for: Several people in one place, with a count: a squad, the people on an order, who’s viewing.

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: Breadcrumbs. Best for: Showing where a page sits in a hierarchy more than one level deep.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Card. Best for: Grouping related content on one surface, or one item in a grid whose whole surface is one link.

items.name: chat-message
items.title: Chat message
items.description: Chat message. Best for: Each turn inside a ChatThread.

items.name: description-list
items.title: Description list
items.description: Description list. Best for: The fixed fields of one record: serial, firmware, owner, dates.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: Dropdown menu. Best for: A short list of actions, under about eight, behind a button.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty state
items.description: Empty state. Best for: A list, table or region with nothing in it, along with the action that fills it.

items.name: form-field
items.title: FormField
items.description: FormField. Best for: The label, help and error for an Input, Textarea, Select, MultiSelect or QuantityStepper.

items.name: list-item
items.title: List item
items.description: List item. Best for: A row people scan in a List: media, a title, meta and one or two actions.

items.name: multi-select
items.title: Multi-select
items.description: Multi-select. Best for: Any number of choices, including none, from a list too long to show all at once.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page header
items.description: Page header. Best for: The top of every screen: its one h1, with eyebrow, description, breadcrumbs and page actions.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Pagination. Best for: Moving through a long list or table one page at a time.

items.name: prompt-input
items.title: Prompt input
items.description: Prompt input. Best for: The message box under a ChatThread.

items.name: quantity-stepper
items.title: Quantity stepper
items.description: Quantity stepper. Best for: A whole number between real limits, such as a quantity in a cart.

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: Rating. Best for: Showing or collecting a score out of five.

items.name: search
items.title: Search
items.description: Search. Best for: Searching the content of the page that shows the results, inside a search landmark.

items.name: section-heading
items.title: Section heading
items.description: Section heading. Best for: Opening a section of a page, at the level that carries on the outline.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented control
items.description: Segmented control. Best for: Switching the view of the same content in place: Board or Table, 24 h or 7 d.

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: Stat. Best for: One headline number and how it has moved. Up to four in a row.

items.name: status-tracker
items.title: Status tracker
items.description: Status tracker. Best for: The health history of one service or device, such as uptime over 30 or 90 days.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Stepper. Best for: Showing where someone is in a flow of two to five steps.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs. Best for: Switching between equally important sections of one view.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Timeline. Best for: A record of what happened to one thing, newest or oldest first: a shipment, a depot, an account.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Toast. Best for: Confirming something the person just did, for a few seconds.

items.name: tool-call
items.title: Tool call
items.description: Tool call. Best for: An assistant reply that ran a tool, such as a query, a lookup or a calculation.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert dialog
items.description: Alert dialog. Best for: Confirming an action that matters and can't be undone, such as a delete.

items.name: auth-form
items.title: Auth form
items.description: Auth form. Best for: Sign in, create an account, reset a password or enter a two-step code.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Carousel. Best for: A sideways preview of more items than fit, with a link to the full list nearby.

items.name: cart
items.title: Cart
items.description: Cart. Best for: The lines someone means to buy: quantities, line totals, a subtotal and removal that can be undone.

items.name: chart-panel
items.title: Chart panel
items.description: Chart panel. Best for: One chart (a line over time, bars by category, a donut of one whole, or a radar of several measures) with a summary sentence and the numbers as a table.

items.name: chat-thread
items.title: Chat thread
items.description: Chat thread. Best for: A conversation with an assistant, above a PromptInput, where replies stream in.

items.name: checkout-form
items.title: Checkout form
items.description: Checkout form. Best for: A demo checkout: shipping, delivery and payment in three steps beside the order summary.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command palette
items.description: Command palette. Best for: Every action in one place behind Ctrl+K, with a visible button that opens it too.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: Data table. Best for: Records people read, compare and sort across columns, with optional bulk selection.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Dialog. Best for: A focused task on top of the page, such as an edit form.

items.name: footer
items.title: Footer
items.description: Footer. Best for: The bottom of a site: link groups, a section of your own, the small print and the wordmark.

items.name: kanban-board
items.title: Kanban board
items.description: Kanban board. Best for: Work items that move through a few named stages, where the point is seeing every stage at once.

items.name: navbar
items.title: Navbar
items.description: Navbar. Best for: The top of a site: the brand, up to about six main links and a few actions.

items.name: newsletter-form
items.title: Newsletter form
items.description: Newsletter form. Best for: Collecting one email address for a newsletter, with a consent line.

items.name: product-card
items.title: Product card
items.description: Product card. Best for: One product in a shop grid, where the whole card opens it and Add to cart sits on it.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Sheet. Best for: Filters, navigation on a narrow screen, or one item's details next to a list, sliding in from the side.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Sidebar. Best for: App navigation down the side: grouped pages with icons and counts.
